title: Closed pushforward comparison for categorical formal kernels
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $Q$ a quasi-coherent ideal on $X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Choose an Abelian structure on $\operatorname{Coh}(X,Q)$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. Let $M,N\in\operatorname{Coh}(X,Q)$, $G,D\in\operatorname{Coh}(Z,Q\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and morphisms $a:M\to N$, $\alpha:G\to D$. Suppose isomorphisms of underlying inverse systems $e:M\cong j_*G$, $d:N\cong j_*D$ satisfy $d\circ a=(j_*\alpha)\circ e$. For any limiting kernel fork $k$ of $\alpha$, there is an isomorphism of inverse systems $(\operatorname{Ker}(a))_\bullet\cong j_*(k.\mathrm{pt})_\bullet$. This asserts no termwise kernel formula and requires no annihilation hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 087T (lemma-i-star-equivalence), 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine), 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian); closed quotient replacement in Theorem 088E. Verified against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087T, /087W, /087X and /088E.

proof.text: Closed coherent pushforward is the termwise equivalence onto systems supported on the closed subscheme. On each Noetherian affine the formal-module equivalence identifies it with restriction of scalars from the quotient of the completed ring. The inverse limits and their actions agree, and restriction of scalars preserves kernels of finite modules. Thus the pushed formal kernel is the categorical formal kernel on this affine.
The canonical affine kernel identifications commute with restriction. Local exactness identifies the pushed fork as a limiting kernel fork globally.
Transport this fork by e and d using the commuting square. Uniqueness of limiting kernel forks identifies its underlying system with that of kernel(a), for the chosen Abelian structure.

theorem closedImmersion_formalKernel_comparison
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (Q : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Abelian (CoherentFormalModule X Q)]
    (M N : CoherentFormalModule X Q)
    (G D : CoherentFormalModule Z (Q.comap j))
    (a : M ⟶ N) (α : G ⟶ D)
    (e : M.obj ≅ G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (d : N.obj ≅ D.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (hsquare : a.hom ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α.hom (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j))
    (k : KernelFork α) (hk : IsLimit k) :
    Nonempty ((kernel a).obj ≅ k.pt.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
